# SolidEdge-MCP — upstream credit

**Project:** SolidEdge-MCP Server  
**Author listed in upstream package metadata:** Tyler Wagler  
**Repository:** https://github.com/tylerwagler/SolidEdge-MCP  
**License:** MIT — see the unmodified upstream LICENSE file beside this document.

The original SolidEdge-MCP repository above was cloned during development of the Inventaur Rhino3D-to-Solid-Edge workflow and is acknowledged as upstream work. The local development clone records origin as the repository above. Its recorded upstream master base was 49384d030c087c643ca3332eb2134bffe393e84c; the local clone also contained a separate local commit.

This credit does not claim that the Tyler Wagler Python MCP server is the source of the separate .NET executables bundled in the beta.3 offline package. Those control/event executables are from a different project and have their own attribution and MIT notice under ThirdParty/DotNet.

The upstream MIT license is retained here without modification.
